jobs.title: Operational Engineer - Student Position
jobs.description: Operational Engineer - Student Position - X-trodes ltd - Career Page Skip To Job Description Join our journey. Operational Engineer - Student Position Herzliya, Central District, Israel Part Time Student (College) Share X-trodes, a vibrant digital health company, is seeking a highly motivated and talented Operational Engineer student to join our team. Key Responsibilities Assemble, calibrate, and repair main components of our leading products. Support production activities and ensure that products meet defined quality and process requirements. Manage and maintain the company's inventory, including receiving, organizing, issuing, and tracking components and products. Ensure accurate inventory records and continuous tracking of inventory movements . Manage customer orders from initiation to delivery, ensuring adherence to timelines and quality requirements. Prepare and maintain professional documentation, including work instructions, assembly procedures, quality guidelines, and other operational documents. Regularly update and maintain logistics and operational files to ensure data accuracy and reliability. Work closely with R&D and other teams to support production and improve operational processes. Identify process gaps and assist in implementing practical improvements . Requirements Ability to work independently, take ownership of tasks, and work effectively as part of a team. Hands-on approach and good technical skills – A must . Strong organizational skills and high attention to detail. Ability to manage multiple tasks, prioritize effectively, and meet deadlines. Experience reading drawings and technical documents – An advantage. Good written and verbal communication skills in Hebrew and English – A must. Previous experience with assembly, manufacturing, laboratory work, or other hands-on technical work – an advantage . U p to 4 years of relevant experience. Experience working with Priority Systems – An advantage. Experience with product design, CAD, or other design-related work – an advantage . Position Details - Student position – Part-time The position is suitable for: Students who have completed their 1st or 2nd year of undergraduate studies and are entering their 2nd or 3rd year, respectively, in Industrial Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field. 2nd year students from other fields. Candidates with a relevant technical background who are not currently enrolled in an academic program, for a part-time position. Share Apply Apply for this position Required *

jobs.title: Senior System Engineer
jobs.description: Senior System Engineer - X-trodes ltd - Career Page Skip To Job Description Join our journey. Senior System Engineer Herzliya, Israel, Israel Full Time Experienced Share We are searching for a senior system engineer for a medical device company with extensive experience in HW, FW and familiarity with analog signal processing. The ideal candidate should possess vast experience in HW design and integration testing in the areas of HMI (Human Machine Interface), Health Care, or Medical Devices. The candidate should be a proven hands-on technology leader. Responsibilities: Define and lead system architecture and implementation of new and existing medical devices, including sub-system definitions, from inception to deployment. Design early-stage prototypes, from proof of concept to new products, covering all disciplines. Coordinate cross-functional activities as part of the multidisciplinary R&D team, including HW design, software design, mechanics, medical regulatory activities, and engineering tasks. Reporting to VP R&D. Master the complete system architecture and serve as a technical authority. Lead resolution of complex technical issues Lead the development of HW and testing procedures Define product V&V documents and finalize reports. Lead the testing & certification process of the system (internal and external labs). Lead engineering and NPI processes Work with subcontractors on different engineering aspects, including HW design, Mechanical design and production engineering. Requirements: B.Sc. in Electrical Engineering Solid background (academic degree or experience) in electronics and software design. At least 4 years of experience in system level activities for multidisciplinary devices, including the full life cycle of design, regulatory compliance and transfer to production. Proficiency in HW design tools (OrCad, Allegro, Altium, other) - a must Experience in a startup setting – an advantage Experience in a medical device company – an advantage Proficiency in SW programming – an advantage Proficiency in analog circuit design– an advantage Share Apply Apply for this position Required *
